evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/services/actions/api_call.rs:308 — ApiCallExecutor::with_ip_resolver() does `reqwest::Client::builder().timeout(60s).user_agent(..).redirect(..).dns_resolver(SsrfGuardResolver).build().expect("Failed to create HTTP client")`. reqwest::ClientBuilder::build() is fallible (TLS backend init, proxy-from-env parse); on failure this panics instead of returning a Result the caller can log and fail-closed on.

This is the exact same pattern the team already accepted and fixed in this segment: done finding code-review-api-core-push-fanout-client-build-expect ('push_fanout.rs builds 3 reqwest clients with .expect() in production constructors'). push_fanout.rs:433/626/1042 were the flagged trio; they are now addressed, leaving api_call.rs:308 as the only remaining production (non-test) fallible-build().expect() in the api-core services layer (test module in this file starts at L604). The fix mirrors the accepted one: make the constructor (or a try_new) return Result and have the composition root log a precise 'workflow HTTP transport misconfigured' error.
